analyzed_vuln.description: `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` assumes every atom query is an `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` and does an unchecked `static_cast` (`atom->getQuery()` -> `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY*`). For the PoV, parsing `M  RBC ... -2` in `ParseRingBondCountLine()` creates a composite `AtomAnd` query (via `replaceAtomWithQueryAtom()` + `expandQuery(..., COMPOSITE_AND)`) and sets `_NeedsQueryScan`. During `finishMolProcessing()`, `completeMolQueries()` is called and downcasts that `AtomAnd` root to `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY`, triggering UB (invalid downcast).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must be a mol block that sets `_NeedsQueryScan` through ring-bond-count parsing with value `-2` (e.g. `M  RBC  1   1  -2`) on an atom that becomes/query-is represented as a composite `AtomAnd`. Data flow: `MolDataStreamToMol()` -> `ParseMolBlockProperties()` -> `ParseRingBondCountLine()` (marks `_NeedsQueryScan`, builds composite query) -> `finishMolProcessing()` -> `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` invalid cast and UBSan crash.
